headword: {計画停電|けいかくていでん}

definitions.explanation: A power cut imposed in turn on different areas at announced times, to keep demand within a reduced supply. In Japan the word is tied to the weeks after the March 2011 earthquake, when eastern Japan had rolling blackouts.

examples.japanese: {計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the times for tomorrow's planned outage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}え→消える：02520_kieru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧になった。
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rolling blackouts turned off the traffic lights and the town went pitch-dark.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (plan) + ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧ (power cut). Used with ⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧ (to carry out) in news and official notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to carry out rolling blackouts
- {計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: areas subject to the planned outage
- {計画停電|けいかくていでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for a planned outage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power cut — any outage, usually unplanned
- ⟦{節電|せつでん}→節電：07136_setsuden⟧: saving electricity — the voluntary measure that is meant to avoid blackouts
